area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: The app opens on the list of chats, with one chat: Will
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: someone signs up whom nobody invited
then: the list shows Will, pinned on top, with his three-dot mark
under it, “Add someone to chat with”, and the round +
before the chat is set up, + shows “Before you share your link, set the questions for people who join.” with “Set them”
note: The list is the app's own. Will's first line for someone nobody invited is drafted.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Will asks what you do, and you type it in Will's chat
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person opens Will and taps “Let's start”
then: the box opens in Will's chat and the person types their work
Will works out what fits that work: the choices on every later screen
nothing is copied from another person's chat
note: On main the setup still starts a new host from Artur's five questions (starting_questions); N612 item 2 says it starts blank.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: One decision per screen: Keep or Change
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: Will has suggestions for this person
then: it shows one line from Will, one thing, and two buttons: Change and Keep
Change shows Will's next suggestion
“Type my own” goes to Will's chat for the words and comes back to the same screen

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: What people send: tick all that apply
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches what people send
then: a recording, a message, a photo, a file, each with a tick; Will's first suggestion comes ticked
several can be ticked; Done keeps them
note: A recording and a typed message exist; a photo is in backend #1880; a file is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: What they get back is the chat's own output
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches what people get back
then: an answer, their own words tidied, what to do next, or a mark on what they sent
for a speaking coach Will suggests their own words tidied (the Ideal Text); for another specialist, an answer

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: The hello, the first questions and what people can tap
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches the chat's first lines
then: the hello, then up to three first questions, one at a time, with “Ask one more question?”
three taps people can ask with, and “Something else” always there (N604)
a host's own words pass the same checks as Will's (no score, no verdict)
note: The recipe keeps the welcome, the questions and how people answer (#1856). The taps as question types are not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: A model is one question with three answers
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
then: the card shows one question and its three answers
Change shows another; “Type my own” takes the person's own question, then one of three sets of answers
a model that already exists and fits what people send is offered first, with its price in tokens, paid by the host
note: Starting a model is backend #1867, in the merge queue; adding someone's model to your chat is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: You teach it, then it guesses and you check
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
then: the person answers the model's question on examples (10 in the app)
then the model guesses first and the person taps Keep, or Change and the right answer
each answer and each fix teaches the model

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Who answers: the shadow, only you, or your assistant
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
then: “I draft the answer. You check it and send it.” comes first
Change: “Only you answer. I stay quiet.”, then “I answer at once. You correct me.”
the assistant answers by itself only after its minimum (N606)
note: The shadow and the assistant exist for a host's chat; the minimum is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Sharing a model, and its price in tokens
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person has a model of their own
when: Will asks “Let others use your models?”
then: Yes asks the price per use, in tokens; Not now keeps it private
tokens come from the existing top-up; earned tokens are credited to spend in the app; nothing pays out in money
note: The price, the split and the crediting are backend #1866, in the merge queue.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: See it as your people do, then open it
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
then: the chat plays one screen at a time as someone who came to it: the hello, the first questions, what they send, what they get back, each model's line, “Was this useful?”
“Open your chat to people?” Yes makes it live; Not yet keeps it saved
Will's chat then shows the link to the chat's parts, each open to change
note: “Was this useful?” is drawn, not decided.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Something that doesn't exist yet goes on the wish list
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person asks for a piece the app doesn't have
when: they type it in Will's chat
then: Will says it isn't available yet
the wish is kept and emailed to the founder as a design element request
